newEntry.name: Stack & Transfer
newEntry.desc: Snip 32 runners, glue three shouldered posts into a calibrated base and lift four annular rings for a 15-move transfer ritual. Measured sheet/carrier reference, customizable ring sizes and fits, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL base grips; connected-card, eight part STLs and assembly ZIP. Adhesive required; rings intentionally lift out.
